|game_text=At each system a player controls with a capital starship, non-[Presence] characters (and vehicles) deploy -1 to related sites and sectors. If you occupy a system with a capital starship (or three unique starships) and have no Objective on table, may add 1 to each of your Force drains at related battleground sites (opponent loses no more than 2 Force from those drains).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Nothing Can Get Through Our Shield (V)]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image here is the Master List slip ([[:File:VB5-01E-Nothing_Can_Get_Through_Our_Shield-PC-E3-master-list.png]]). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes.
* '''Original''' ([[Nothing Can Get Through Our Shield (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009).<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 2, slip 01E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “01E” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Nothing Can Get Through Our Shield (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) changed “starship, non- characters” to “starship, his non-[Presence] characters” and changed “characters (and vehicles)” to “characters and vehicles”.<ref name="cl-1250_1-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Nothing Can Get Through Our Shield (V) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-nothingcangetthroughourshield-pre.gif]]) prints the card-list text again, word for word: “At each system a player controls with a capital starship, his non-[Presence] characters and vehicles deploy -1 to related sites and sectors. If you occupy a system with a capital starship (or three unique starships) and have no Objective on table, may add 1 to each of your Force drains at related battleground sites (opponent loses no more than 2 Force from those drains).” '''What changed:''' Nothing in the words: the card image prints the card-list words exactly. The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual5-Dark) lists the file, with every other file in it, as last modified on 25 February 2013<ref name="r6-Virtual5-Dark">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034650/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual5-Dark/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 25 February 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>; it is dated by that upload date, after the card list and before the Master List. The date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier, but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). It is a version of its own even though its words repeat an earlier text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture, and prints the slip number “01E” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 3)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=3, page 3. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the original printed text again, word for word: “At each system a player controls with a capital starship, non-[Presence] characters (and vehicles) deploy -1 to related sites and sectors. If you occupy a system with a capital starship (or three unique starships) and have no Objective on table, may add 1 to each of your Force drains at related battleground sites (opponent loses no more than 2 Force from those drains).” '''What changed:''' “non-[Presence] characters (and vehicles)” again, for the card list's “his non-[Presence] characters and vehicles”. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). As the latest publication it is the current text. The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip is the lower part of the card, as on the release sheet; at bottom right it prints only the “E” mark, without the slip number “01” of the release-sheet slip (“01E”). GEMP's current card plays this text: both players' non-[Presence] characters and vehicles get the deploy discount (play change from the card-list text, approved by Bill, 11 November 2026).
